title: Set admin_port in port being used does not throw error
review_reason: admin_port conflict is a startup/socket-binding diagnostic issue. Requires controlled occupied port inside dedicated namespace, admin_address/startup configuration and startup-log oracle. Ordinary no-network SQL runner cannot exercise it; original admin_address is also absent.
